# Derivatives

Table of derivatives:

$$
\begin{align}
y(x) = x^n \Rightarrow \frac{dy}{dx} = nx^{n-1} \\
y(x) = u(x) v(x) \Rightarrow \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{du}{dx} v + u \frac{dv}{dx} \\
y(x) = \frac{u(x)}{v(x)}  \Rightarrow \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\frac{du}{dx} v - u \frac{dv}{dx}}{v^2}
\end{align}
$$
